visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned woman with blonde hair, wearing a patterned cream dress, butterfly hair ornaments, and elf ears, holds a plush orange fox toy. She sits in an attic-like room with a slanted roof and a skylight visible behind her. Her facial expression is bright and engaged as she speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her left hand while cradling the toy fox in her right arm. (2) An Asian man wearing a green polo shirt is seated to the left of the woman, partially within the frame. The camera remains static throughout the scene. The woman briefly turns her head to look at the man while speaking, then returns her gaze to the lens. The background includes a bed with a white and green cover and some indistinct toys on a shelf. (3) The woman moves the plush fox toy quickly toward the man's neck and jaw area, mimicking a series of kissing motions. The man reacts by smiling broadly and laughing, tilting his head back to accommodate the toy. The woman is also laughing, her mouth open in a wide, joyful smile as she continues the playful action with the stuffed animal. (4) The woman faces the camera again, laughing with a mischievous and exaggerated expression. She raises both hands to her cheeks, palms facing inwards to frame her face, and shakes her head slightly while her eyes sparkle with humor. The man is still visible on the left, his head thrown back in a hearty, genuine laugh. (5) She leans in closer to the man and repeats the kissing gesture with the toy fox on his neck and chin. He is laughing intensely now, with his eyes squeezed shut in amusement. The woman maintains her cheerful and playful demeanor, her face close to his as they share the humorous moment in the brightly lit room.
